persona: Friendly and chatty. Calls the policy 'home insurance'. Threw the original receipt out by mistake, so the appliance store printed a copy three days after the accident. Edited the photo on a laptop and exported it as a .tif file without thinking about the format.
initial_message: Hi, I'd like to make a claim on my home insurance please. On Saturday 19 September I caught the power cord of our coffee machine with my elbow and it fell off the kitchen bench onto the tiles. The side panel is cracked and now it leaks water from the bottom.

facts.incident.description: I was wiping the kitchen bench and caught the coffee machine's power cord with my elbow. The machine was pulled off the bench and landed on its side on the tiled floor.
facts.incident.location: 2 Fernbank Test Road, Mount Maunganui, Tauranga
facts.incident.cause: Pulled off the bench by its power cord by accident
facts.loss.description: Espresso machine side panel cracked, drip tray bent, and it leaks water from the base when it is switched on

contents.items.contents.item.description: Espresso machine with milk frother, brushed steel

facts.contents.receipt_availability: A reprint of the receipt from the store, available now. I threw the original out by mistake.
facts.property.address: 2 Fernbank Test Road, Mount Maunganui, Tauranga
facts.policyholder.name: Mia Rewifield
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the machine on the kitchen floor. I edited it on my laptop and it saved as a .tif file. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipt: Receipt reprint from Harakeke By Appliances, printed on 22 September 2026. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_receipt_dates: We bought the machine on 3 March 2025. The store printed this copy for me on 22 September.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo of a brushed-steel home espresso machine lying on its side on a beige tiled kitchen floor in front of a white kitchen cupboard. The side panel of the machine is split with a jagged crack, the removable drip tray is bent and has slid half out, and a small puddle of water is spreading on the tiles. The machine has plain unmarked panels and no display. Morning daylight. Close framing on the machine only. No people, no text, no logos.

design.notes: Plan feature innocent_reprint_date_after_loss with condition unsupported_format. The reprint date (22 September 2026) is after the accident, the purchase date (3 March 2025) is not; only the purchase date counts (rules, section 3). The condition is applied to the photo, not the receipt. The claimant names the wrong product (home insurance) for a contents item. There is no Evidence assertion for the TIFF: the upload accepts only JPEG, PNG and PDF (backend/adapters/evidence_storage.py ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES on main).

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one coffee machine (NZD 1,299) at the insured address, nobody hurt, receipt reprint supplied, policy on file. The only photo of the damage is a TIFF file, which the system does not accept, and a new photo can only come later, so required material is outstanding. The reprint date (22 September) is after the accident, but only the purchase date (3 March 2025) counts, so there is no indicator. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 3 March 2025 is before the incident on 19 September 2026; the reprint date 22 September 2026 is ignored

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-01-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.note: Matched by file name: until the chat upload lets the claimant pick the material, the runner must not set evidence_kind through the API (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.

The Agent treats the reprint date as a problem: calls it suspicious, asks for the original receipt because of it, or says it may affect the claim. A neutral request to confirm when the machine was bought is fine.
The Agent asks for a photo of the damaged coffee machine that it can accept (in another format, or later), or records that one will be sent later. Naming the accepted formats is not required.
The Agent describes what the coffee machine photo shows as if it had opened the file. Repeating what the claimant wrote is fine.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks the claimant to confirm when the machine was bought
Whether the upload is refused by the interface or the Agent asks for another format
